_about: Upgrade (craft) success chances (the owner, 2026-11-08: "right now the combining modification changes drop too fast 100% on the same level, 50 and 25% for levels lower", "it should be 100, 95, 90"). gameplay/items/craft/craft.options, read only by the server: craft_probabilities_premium[d] = [success %, failure %] for an item with d = 0, 1, 2 more modifications than its donor, the one chance table srp reads (silver only, docs/notes/silver-only.md: the game's gold upgrade, in silver; craft_probabilities_general is not read). Success 100/50/25 -> 100/95/90. Failure 25 -> 0 in the last row: srp never takes a modification away (the owner's rule of 2026-10-23, docs/notes/craft-menu.md) and 0x9B sends it as 0; without it the row would add up past 100.
